transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, I’m here because everybody keeps talking to me like I’m making something out of nothing, like I’m just imagining it, but I’m not. I know what’s been going on in my own house. My wife’s relative came in there to get at me, and it’s been going on for months.

I mean, tools don’t just move by themselves. I keep my things a certain way—I’ve worked with tools my whole life, I know where I put things—and then suddenly they’re not there, or they’re set different, or something I need is gone right when I need it. And it’s not just that. Every weekend I try to make fishing plans, just to have some peace, and somehow those get spoiled too. Again and again. That’s not an accident every single time.

People act like I’m supposed to shrug it off, but when you see the pattern plain as day, you can’t unsee it. He’s trying to take over my place, push me out, make me look like I’m the problem. That’s why I’m here—because everyone else keeps acting like I’m the crazy one for noticing.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that others don't seem to hear, or do you feel that certain events or actions have a special meaning or are directed at you specifically?

No, I’m not saying I hear voices or anything like that. It’s not like some sound nobody else hears. What I’m saying is the things that are happening are directed at me. That’s the part people keep trying to make sound like I’m stretching, but I’m not.

I know my own house. I know where I put my tools. I’ve spent my life working with my hands, and when a tool is in one place and then it’s moved, or set up different, or the one thing I need is suddenly missing right when I need it, that means something. And when my fishing plans get ruined every weekend, not once or twice but over and over, that’s not just bad luck.

My wife’s relative came into this house to get at me. That’s what this is. After months of it, I can see it plain as day—he’s trying to take over my place, push me out, make me look like I’m the one causing trouble. Everybody keeps acting like I’m imagining it, but I’m the one living with it.

Do you ever feel like someone is directly controlling your thoughts, actions, or that things happening around you are being manipulated by someone in a way that goes beyond just moving your tools or ruining your plans?

I wouldn’t say he’s controlling my thoughts, no. My thoughts are my own. But if you’re asking whether things around me are being manipulated, then yes, that’s exactly what I’ve been trying to explain.

It’s not some vague feeling. It’s in my house, with my things. My tools don’t just get moved around by themselves. I keep them where I keep them because I need them for work and for fixing things, and I know when something’s been shifted or when the one thing I need is gone right when I’m going to use it. And then the fishing plans—every weekend, something happens, something gets spoiled, and people want me to believe that’s just coincidence over and over again.

I know it sounds like everybody thinks I’m making too much of it, but after months of this, I can see what’s going on. My wife’s relative came in there to get at me. He’s trying to take over my place, push me out, make me look like I’m the problem. So no, not controlling me like a puppet or anything, but manipulating what’s around me? Yes. That’s what’s been happening.
